hero.intro: Squarespace website design for creatives, studios, restaurants and personal brands. We style it well past the template, set up the galleries, shop or blog, and leave you with a site that's easy to run. Fixed quote first.

items.p: We start from a Squarespace template because you have to. Then custom styling makes it unrecognisable.
Portfolio and gallery layouts chosen for your work. Big where it should be big, quiet where it shouldn't.
Squarespace's built-in shop handles a modest catalogue, bookings and digital downloads without extra software.
A journal, a menu, an events page. Set up so adding to it takes minutes.
Every page checked on a phone, where pictures crop differently and menus misbehave.
One login, one bill, no updates to manage. We show you where everything lives.

fit.p: Squarespace does a few things well and doesn't pretend otherwise. If your site is mostly pictures, words and a way to get in touch, it's hard to argue with.
yes: A photographer, designer, architect or maker
A restaurant, cafe or small hotel
Building a portfolio or a personal brand
Not interested in maintaining anything, ever
fit.no: you need custom features or lots of integrations. Squarespace has firm walls. [Webflow](/services/webflow-website-design/) gives more freedom, and [Wix](/services/wix-website-design/) has more built-in tools for bookings.

items.p: A free call, a look at your photos and words, a page list and a fixed quote.
We design the look on two or three key pages first, so you can react to something real.
Every page built on your own Squarespace account, with the galleries, shop or blog set up.
Domain connected, a walkthrough of your own site, and 30 days of free fixes.

price.p: Our fixed plans run from $1,299 to $6,499, about AED 4,800 to 23,900. A site takes 3 to 6 weeks, mostly depending on how ready your photos and words are. Squarespace's subscription is separate and paid to them.

tools.note: One platform, one login, one bill. And no partner badge.

faq.q: Can you make Squarespace look custom?
faq.a: Yes. Custom styling changes the type, spacing, colours and layouts well beyond what the settings panel offers. Nobody should be able to name the template.

faq.q: Can I manage the site after launch?
faq.a: Easily. It's one of the simplest platforms to run, and we walk you through your own site, not a generic tutorial.

faq.q: Can you move my site to Squarespace?
faq.a: Yes. We bring your pages, posts and images across and set up redirects so old links still work.

faq.q: Is Squarespace enough for a shop?
faq.a: For a small catalogue, yes. Once you're managing lots of products, stock and delivery rules, you'll want [Shopify](/services/shopify-website-design/). We'd rather tell you now than rebuild it in a year.
